# Authorization

OAuth authorization endpoint (consent / code), used by the Burq MCP connector.

3 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

## Operations

| Method | Path | operationId |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/connect/authorize`](#op-authorization-authorizeget) | Authorization_AuthorizeGET |
| POST | [`/connect/authorize`](#op-authorization-authorizepost) | Authorization_AuthorizePOST |
| POST | [`/connect/token`](#op-authorization-exchange) | Authorization_Exchange |

<a id="op-authorization-authorizeget"></a>
### GET `/connect/authorize`

operationId `Authorization_AuthorizeGET` · Authorization endpoint. Sends the user to the consent screen when no consent session
exists, and otherwise issues the authorization code.

Parameters: _none_

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | file | A redirect to the consent page, or the authorization response. |

<a id="op-authorization-exchange"></a>
### POST `/connect/token`

operationId `Authorization_Exchange` · Token endpoint. Exchanges an authorization code, or a refresh token, for an access token.

Parameters: _none_

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | file | The token response. |
